intent: Seek a substantial additional gain by recovering ownership evidence and improving endpoints, preserving current gains and all failed methods.
data: Public labels only, frozen buffered/purged/100-second folds. No private or corrected labels, final frame patches, video/annotation access, cloud processing or submission. Future observations bounded to125frames and padded through18934.
ranked_hypotheses: Current asymmetric contact history misses pass-flight ownership. Add bounded bidirectional exclusive-contact age, repeated-contact fractions and same-team bracketing features.
Nearest-player geometry misses receivers. Add projected-ball-to-team corridor distances and actual future-ball distances to current player sets, without track identity assumptions.
Automatic phase semantics can qualify ambiguous brief control when fused with temporal physical evidence in a learned model rather than copied as labels.
State classifiers do not directly learn transitions. Later freeze a separate directed boundary head if the ownership screen does not yield substantial stable gains.
Visible stoppages require persistence and changing player organization. Later freeze a distinct stoppage-context model rather than globally reducing D confidence.

screen.training: Same ordered XGBoost depth3,160trees,.04 learning rate,lambda10,min_child_weight15; H/A swap augmentation. Fit and weights only eligible training labels. Frame objective class balances; runs objective gives eligible contiguous runs equal mass.
screen.replace_current: Replace only the ordered current-model probabilities; retain older ensemble, fast head, canonical consensus and anchored rescue.
screen.short_proposals: Keep anchored emissions except automatically decoded new-model H/A proposals8..125frames; mean new-model team probability>=.65; at least3 instantaneous contact-supported frames OR3 same-team before/after bracketing frames; current surrounding opposite ownership, no overlap with decoded D. Use new conditional team emissions inside proposal only, preserving D. Same-team bracket uses touch2_bracket_75>=.1 (bounded75-frame past/future contact).

confirmation: Freeze no more than two unchanged methods for seeds42,43,44 and all three protocols. Inspect all paired metrics and block regressions. Later hypotheses require new immutable plans before scoring.

promotion.all_pairs: No stitched spellF1 loss, MacroF1>=reference-.005, D recall>=reference-.02, no extra mostly missed stoppages, and no previously mostly recovered short true run may become mostly missed.
promotion.substantial: Buffered primary gain>=.04 in every seed, plus positive mean primary gain in each other protocol. Improve short-run mean best IoU or mostly missed stoppages, and false D may not increase by more than10frames in any pair.
promotion.selection: Among passing finalists prefer largest mean paired primary gain across protocols/seeds; tie by short IoU then fewer false D. Retain seed42. If no finalist passes, retain anchored default and continue distinct predeclared hypotheses.

limitations: Same17 repeatedly inspected possessions, overlapping training sets and adaptive selection; not independent or full-match accuracy or significance evidence.
